tables.name: users
tables.purpose: One row per person who can sign in. The MVP seeds exactly one and checks credentials in code, but the table exists so multiple users need no reshaping later.

tables.name: boards
tables.purpose: A Kanban board belonging to a user. The MVP seeds one per user.

columns.name: name
columns.notes: Shown as the board heading, e.g. Product Roadmap

columns.name: subtitle
columns.notes: Shown under the heading, e.g. Q4 delivery board

tables.name: board_columns
tables.purpose: The fixed columns of a board. Renamable, but not addable or removable in the MVP.

columns.name: id
columns.notes: uuid v4. Text so the same id travels unchanged through the API, the Flutter models, and the AI prompt.

columns.name: position
columns.notes: Left to right order within the board, contiguous from 0

columns.name: id
columns.notes: uuid v4, same reasoning as board_columns.id

columns.name: position
columns.notes: Top to bottom order within the column, contiguous from 0

tables.name: messages
tables.purpose: Chat history for the AI sidebar, so a conversation survives a reload and can be replayed to the model.

columns.name: id
columns.notes: Also the chronological order; messages are read ORDER BY id

columns.name: board_id
columns.notes: Scoped to the board rather than the user, because the conversation is about a specific board

invariants.rule: cards.position is contiguous from 0 within each column_id
invariants.reason: A UNIQUE (column_id, position) constraint would fire mid-statement while a reindexing UPDATE shifts rows, so the invariant is upheld in code instead of declared.

invariants.rule: board_columns.position is contiguous from 0 within each board_id
invariants.reason: Columns cannot be added, removed, or reordered in the MVP, so nothing changes this after creation.

invariants.rule: Every request resolves the board from the signed in user, never from a client-supplied board id
invariants.reason: Keeps one user from reading or writing another user's board.

seed.condition: Applied on first run only, when the users table is empty.

notOnTheSchema.reason: MVP credentials are hardcoded in the login route. Adding an unused column now would imply an authentication story that does not exist.
Nothing in the API surface or the UI reads them. Ordering comes from position for cards and from id for messages.
The MVP has one board per user, but constraining it would make a second board a migration rather than an insert.
